approved: Telecommunications and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2025

Moved the second reading of the Telecommunications and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2025, arguing that it would clarify surveillance, interception, international production orders and controlled operations frameworks. The bill would support access to certain stored communications, strengthen safeguards and assist investigations of serious online crime, including child exploitation, while retaining strict controls.

Presented reports supporting the listing of Terrorgram as a terrorist organisation under the Criminal Code and recommending passage without amendment of the Telecommunications and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2025, which makes technical changes to telecommunications, surveillance and criminal justice laws.
